title: NEGBINOMDIST evaluates Loader's saddle-point mass times p/(s+f), drifting on exact dyadic rationals at p = 0.25
statement: In Excel 16.0.20131 and 16.0.20527, the legacy PMF-only NEGBINOMDIST(number_f, number_s, probability_s) rejects raw number_f < 0 before truncating counts toward zero, requires truncated s >= 1 and 0 < p < 1 (#NUM! otherwise), preserves subnormal exp(s * ln(p)) at f = 0, and for f > 0 evaluates the saddle-point binomial mass of s - 1 successes in s + f - 1 trials with -ln(s + f) in the running exponential followed by stored RN53(RN64(p / (s + f))) (flushed if subnormal). On exact dyadic rationals =NEGBINOMDIST(10,5,0.25) and =NEGBINOMDIST(1,5,0.25), Excel is 1 ULP low and 2 ULP high.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20131 (1,801/1,804 full-bank and 120/120 pinned NEGBINOMDIST rows) and 16.0.20527.20088 in dcztvv_r24 (rows 3876, 3889) and prefix_metadata (row 160).
